title: Foundry agent definitions
description: The one definition of every agent: one row per package under packages/, the named agent lists code reads, and the chain handoffs. scripts/check-agents-definition.mjs reads this schema, joins every other declaration of an agent to the rows and writes the generated copies packages read.

package.description: The workspace package name in packages/<id>/package.json.

class.description: How the code treats the agent: content agents own slots and loops, factory agents plan, build and review Foundry's own work, tooling ships deterministic mechanics and is not a role, other is every other role.

definitionOwner.description: The agent that owns this definition.

rung.description: The readiness rung. Null until the readiness ladder computes it.

lists.description: Named, ordered agent lists, owned by Controller. Code reads a list by name through a generated copy instead of writing the ids out. Each member is a row id, at most once; the content list's members are exactly the rows of class content.

description.description: What the list is and who reads it.

members.description: Row ids, in the order code reads them.

handoffs.description: The chain handoffs: which agent feeds which.

items.description: Upstream row id, then downstream row id.
